ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡¿Cómo se me ocurriría venir
a comprar en ayunas?!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ¡Estoy
superhambriento, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0022:}}J'ai super chaud,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Je

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Karnım zil çalıyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sometimes just walking around
Main Street really hits the chill spot.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A veces solo con pasearme un poco
por esta calle ya me quedo de lo
más tranquilo. ¡Me da buen rollo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Parfois, rien que de faire du
lèche-vitrine, ça fait du bien.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A volte basta fare un bel giro
in Via degli Acquisti per tirarsi
su di morale.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Manchmal könnte ich den ganzen
Tag nur hier herumlaufen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bazen Ana Cadde’de öylesine dolaşmak
bile insanın keyfini yerine getiriyor.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tu as acheté beaucoup de choses,

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}A huh huh huh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'm going on a
shopping spree today!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Je, je, je!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Hoy voy a fundírmelo
TODO comprando lo que pille!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Youhou !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Je crois que je vais tout
acheter !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ah ah ah!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Adoro essere in preda
a questi attacchi di shopping!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Äh, he he he!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Heute hau ich mein
ganzes Taschengeld auf den Kopf!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ah hah hah!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bugün alışverişin

EN:
Shopping is best when you can do it
at your own pace.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} And I like to take
my time,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
Comprar está bien cuando nadie te
mete prisa.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} A mí me gusta hacerlo
todo con calma,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
Moi, j'aime bien prendre mon temps
pour faire mes courses.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est vrai,
quoi. Ça sert à rien de courir.
IT:
È bello prendersela comoda quando
si fa shopping.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} E io me la prendo
mooolto comoda,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
Gemütlich einkaufen ist echt das
Beste,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
Alışveriş en güzeli kendi hızında
yapılınca.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ben de ağırdan almayı
severim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
I like walking around Main Street at
this time of night.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}It's much more
relaxed{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} than during the day!
ES:
Me gusta pasear por la zona
comercial a estas horas de la
noche.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Está más tranqui que de día!
FR:
J'aime bien me balader dans le coin
à cette heure-ci.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est beaucoup
plus calme qu'en journée !
IT:
Mi piace passeggiare per Via degli
Acquisti di notte.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}È molto più
rilassante{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} che di giorno!

Gecenin bu saatinde Ana Cadde’de

çok daha sakin{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It's fun to hang out on Main Street
during off hours.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Cómo mola pasar el ratillo
por la zona comercial en cuanto
tengo alguna hora libre!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'aime bien me balader ici pour me
relaxer.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Che bello andare in giro
per Via degli Acquisti
quando la città è così tranquilla.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn die Läden zu sind, kann man
sich endlich mal ungestört die Nase
an den Schaufenstern plattdrücken.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ana Cadde’de ortalık sakinken
takılmak da eğlenceli.
